ios.desc:
Give your eyes the break they're begging for just for a little cost.

Staring at screens all day leaves your eyes dry, tired, red, and strained. Eyecare 20 20 20 fixes that with one gentle reminder every 20 minutes — and now it can run on its own, so you never have to remember to start it.

It's built on the doctor-recommended 20-20-20 rule: every 20 minutes, look at something 20 feet away for 20 seconds. That tiny habit relaxes your eye muscles, reduces digital eye strain, and helps prevent the dryness and redness that come from long screen time.

Set it once, then forget it.

Tell Eyecare your working hours — for example, weekdays from 8 to 4 — and the app starts and stops your reminders automatically on those days. No tapping, no thinking about it. Your eye breaks just happen while you work.

Prefer a nudge instead? Set a fixed daily reminder and the app will tell you when it's time to start, so the habit sticks even on your busiest days.

Three ways to use it — pick what fits you:
* Manual — Tap Start when you begin, tap Stop when you're done.
* Auto-schedule — Choose your days and hours (like weekdays 8–4) and reminders run automatically.
* Daily start reminder — Get a nudge at a fixed time to begin your session.

Dead simple. Zero learning curve.

No accounts. No complicated settings. Whether you run it by hand or let it run itself, Eyecare quietly works in the background while you do.
Why you'll love it

Automatic eye break reminders every 20 minutes
Auto-run on your chosen days and hours — set it and forget it
Daily reminder to start your session on time
Based on the proven 20-20-20 eye care rule
One-tap start and stop
Lightweight and runs quietly in the background
Perfect for anyone who works, studies, games, or scrolls on screens

If you spend hours in front of a computer, phone, or tablet, your eyes are working overtime. Eyecare 20 20 20 gives them the regular rest they need to stay comfortable, clear, and healthy.
Download now and start taking care of your eyes today.
Please note: This is not a free app. We offer a three day trial for you to experience the app, but after that you will need to pay for a subscription.
